responsibility: This module is GCC’s D language frontend integration layer, responsible for compiling D source by connecting the shared DMD-derived frontend to GCC’s language hooks, tree/GIMPLE infrastructure, driver, and target/runtime interfaces. Its core files implement D-specific option and build integration, diagnostics, import search, builtin and intrinsic registration, target-query hooks, and the language hook table, while the main lowering files translate D declarations, types, expressions, statements, attributes, conversions, and module metadata into GCC trees and then gimplify D-specific constructs for the middle end. It also owns compiler-generated interactions with druntime/libphobos such as runtime helper calls, TypeInfo and ModuleInfo emission, static constructor/destructor registration, compile-time floating support, and builtin compiler modules, plus the user and implementation documentation for GDC. Overall, this module represents the complete front-end subsystem that turns D semantics and ABI rules into GCC IR and executable linkage behavior, distinguishing it from generic middle-end optimization modules or target back ends.
